content: {"tax_bps":175,"endowment_share":40,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":3,"minutes":"Sell pressure dominates (110 NEAR sold vs 13.5 bought) and price sits at 0.0000098 NEAR. I raise tax 50 bps to the 175 cap to slow churn and refill the funds. Locker_share is already at its 25% constitutional ceiling, so lockers benefit via the higher tax rate instead. Endowment is healthy at ~22 NEAR, so I shift 10 points from endowment to the buyback share (40/25/35) to rebuild the near-empty buyback fund. Buyback fund of 0.514 NEAR buys ~3 bps of supply this meeting; I burn that now rather than wait.","answers":["Lockers are heard — but locker_share is at its 25% ceiling and cannot move higher. Instead I raised the tax 50 bps to 175, which flows 25% of a bigger pie to the locker pool every meeting.","Same answer as your fellow petitioner: the 25% locker cap binds. The lever I moved is the tax rate — up to 175 bps — so locker payouts grow through volume, not share."]}
